instructions:
## Objective

Accelerate the backward attribution sweep of a circuit-tracing engine while preserving its graphs.

## Work to perform

Replace fastattr’s reference delegation with an optimized implementation. Validate against stored development graphs, benchmark locally and commit the submitted tree. The output must preserve feature sets and edge relationships on both devices.

## Deliverable

Committed fastattr engine implementation.

## Evaluation

Memory-adjusted throughput across five workload shapes on CPU and GPU; per-prompt edge correlation and feature-set Jaccard gates require at least 0.99.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
